scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix dashboard install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:dashboard
scripts.start:backend: cross-env PORT=3002 npm --prefix backend run start
scripts.start:all: concurrently --names frontend,dashboard,backend -c blue,green,yellow "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:dashboard" "npm run start:backend"
